comparison.objective: Align and load four square blanks into a close-clearance gravity magazine; the candidate sets and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated planar pickup, yaw alignment, and vertical insertion versus two-tool rotary adjustment and counter-torque locking.
comparison.success_condition: Score is the number of flat, supported, still blanks inside the channel; candidate requires one precise mechanical setting to remain locked through three cycles.
comparison.reason: Close-clearance insertion does not test adjustable-stop calibration, jam-nut locking, or retained function.
